svg.title: Point mutations as data augmentation for genomic sequences
svg.desc: A coding sequence of eight codons and three augmented copies. A silent mutation changes GCT to GCC and keeps alanine. A missense mutation changes AAA to AGA, lysine to arginine. A nonsense mutation changes TGG to the stop codon TAG. In the paper, silent and missense mutations improved model performance, while nonsense mutations and random mutations in non-coding regions generally degraded it.
svg.text: Codon substitutions in a coding region
Letters under each codon are the encoded amino acids. Substituted bases in pink.
Random mutations in non-coding regions also degraded performance.
